Subject: 20% off Stormline jackets — limited stock, ends Sunday
Preview: Your next wet-weather trip sorted. 20% off while stock lasts.
Body: You've got a trip coming up. The forecast isn't pretty. Here's what you need to know.

The Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket (NB-JKT-07) is built for sustained wet weather. 3-layer laminate construction. 20,000mm waterproof rating keeps rain out; 20,000 g/m² breathability moves moisture out so you're not cooking inside your own jacket. It weighs 420g — light enough that you'll forget it's in your pack until you need it.

This isn't a jacket for summit alpinism or expedition conditions. It's built for long days in the rain: trail running, hiking, shoulder-season ridge walks where the weather turns and you need reliable protection without a lot of bulk.

Right now, 20% off — limited stock available, offer ends Sunday.

One jacket. One decision. Make it before Sunday.
